description: Local-first MCP server for Google Health API v4 (Fitbit + Pixel Watch) — Claude/Cursor/Hermes

tool_signatures.name: google_health_agent_manifest
tool_signatures.description: Machine-readable install, runtime and client guidance for AI agents. Does not call Google Health or expose secrets.

tool_signatures.name: google_health_cache_status
tool_signatures.description: Show optional local SQLite cache status. Enable with GOOGLE_HEALTH_CACHE=sqlite or GOOGLE_HEALTH_CACHE=true.

tool_signatures.name: google_health_capabilities
tool_signatures.description: Explain supported Google Health data, privacy boundaries, beta status and recommended agent workflow.

tool_signatures.name: google_health_connection_status
tool_signatures.description: Check local Google Health config, token file, Node version, privacy mode, cache readiness and optional MCP client readiness without calling Google APIs or exposing secrets.

tool_signatures.name: google_health_daily_rollup
tool_signatures.description: Aggregate a data type over civil days using Google Health dailyRollUp. Useful for steps, distance, calories, active minutes, weight and heart summaries.

tool_signatures.name: google_health_daily_summary
tool_signatures.description: Build a practical daily summary from Google Health rollups and reconciled streams when available. Read-only, beta, non-medical.

tool_signatures.name: google_health_data_inventory
tool_signatures.description: Inventory supported Google Health data types, auth scopes, privacy modes and recommended first calls without calling Google APIs.

tool_signatures.name: google_health_data_type_coverage
tool_signatures.description: Build a data-type coverage plan from the official Google Health API data-type table, or run explicit live read-only checks against a real OAuth account. Live mode returns only redacted status and point-count buckets, never raw health payloads.

tool_signatures.name: google_health_demo
tool_signatures.description: Returns realistic Pixel-Watch-style example payloads of google_health_daily_summary, google_health_wellness_context, and google_health_daily_rollup so agents see the contract before calling real Google Health APIs.

tool_signatures.name: google_health_exchange_code
tool_signatures.description: Exchange a Google OAuth authorization code for local tokens. Tokens are stored locally with 0600 permissions and are never returned. Gated: requires explicit user intent — agents must not call this autonomously.

tool_signatures.name: google_health_get_auth_url
tool_signatures.description: Generate a Google OAuth authorization URL for Google Health API. Use this first when no local token exists.

tool_signatures.name: google_health_get_identity
tool_signatures.description: Get the Google Health identity mapping for the authenticated user. Useful for Fitbit-to-Google migrations.

tool_signatures.name: google_health_get_profile
tool_signatures.description: Get authenticated user profile details from Google Health. Requires profile scope.

tool_signatures.name: google_health_get_settings
tool_signatures.description: Get authenticated user settings such as units and timezone. Requires settings scope.

tool_signatures.name: google_health_list_data_points
tool_signatures.description: Query detailed data points for a Google Health data type. Use kebab-case endpoint data types, e.g. steps, sleep, heart-rate.

tool_signatures.name: google_health_list_data_types
tool_signatures.description: List the canonical kebab-case data_type slugs accepted by the data point, reconcile and rollup tools, with each slug

tool_signatures.name: google_health_onboarding
tool_signatures.description: Return the 11-question onboarding flow plus the current profile state and missing fields. Read-only — does NOT persist anything. Pair with google_health_profile_update once the user answers. Cross-connector: the same profile is shared by every Delx Wellness MCP (whoop, garmin, oura, fitbit, strava, polar, withings, apple-health, samsung-health, google-health, nourish, cycle-coach, cgm, air).

tool_signatures.name: google_health_privacy_audit
tool_signatures.description: Return local privacy, cache, token-path and env-presence posture without revealing secret values.

tool_signatures.name: google_health_profile_get
tool_signatures.description: Read the shared Delx Wellness profile from ~/.delx-wellness/profile.json. Returns preferred name, goals, devices, training/nutrition/exercise/agent preferences and safety flags. NEVER contains OAuth tokens or API secrets. Read-only.

tool_signatures.name: google_health_profile_update
tool_signatures.description: Persist a partial patch to ~/.delx-wellness/profile.json. Requires explicit_user_intent=true (otherwise returns USER_ACTION_REQUIRED). Rejects secret-like fields (oauth, token, secret, password, cookie, refresh, api_key, session) at write time. Use to record preferred name, goals, devices, training context, nutrition context, exercise preferences, agent preferences, and safety flags.

patch.description: Partial WellnessProfileDocument patch. Top-level keys: profile, goals, devices, training, nutrition, preferences, safety, notes.

explicit_user_intent.description: Must be true to persist. Prevents accidental writes from agent inference.

parameters.name: explicit_user_intent
parameters.description: Must be true to persist. Prevents accidental writes from agent inference.

parameters.name: patch
parameters.description: Partial WellnessProfileDocument patch. Top-level keys: profile, goals, devices, training, nutrition, preferences, safety, notes.

tool_signatures.name: google_health_quickstart
tool_signatures.description: Personalized 3-step setup walkthrough for the human user. Adapts to current state (env vars set? token present? what

tool_signatures.name: google_health_reconcile_data_points
tool_signatures.description: Read a reconciled stream for one data type across sources. Supports all-sources, google-wearables and google-sources data source families.

tool_signatures.name: google_health_revoke_access
tool_signatures.description: Revoke the current Google OAuth grant and delete the local token file. Use only when the user explicitly wants to disconnect Google Health. Gated: requires explicit user intent — agents must not call this autonomously.

explicit_user_intent.description: Must be true after the user explicitly asked to disconnect. Prevents agents from revoking autonomously.

parameters.name: explicit_user_intent
parameters.description: Must be true after the user explicitly asked to disconnect. Prevents agents from revoking autonomously.

tool_signatures.name: google_health_rollup
tool_signatures.description: Aggregate a data type over physical time intervals using Google Health rollUp.

tool_signatures.name: google_health_weekly_summary
tool_signatures.description: Build a weekly Google Health scorecard with activity, sleep, heart context and missing-data awareness. Read-only, beta, non-medical.

tool_signatures.name: google_health_wellness_context
tool_signatures.description: Normalize Google Health activity/sleep context into the shared wellness_context shape for recommendation engines.
